entities.summary: Wu Jianmin was a prominent Chinese diplomat. He worked as the spokesman of Chinese Foreign Ministry, ambassador of China to the Netherlands, Permanent Mission to the United Nations Office at Geneva and other International Organizations in Switzerland, and France, and the president of the Bureau International des Expositions.
